empirical_sources.scope: 10 LLM1 documents; historical PDF-reading pilot, not measured V5 cost for new cases
30 already-read DIN cases; JEV scoring plus Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite recommendations
50 already-read mixed-source cases; alternative matching reference

exclusions: Extra documents or materially longer requirements
Paid fallback models or uncertain failed sends
Infrastructure, local OCR compute, taxes and currency conversion
limits: Historical samples are small and selected; these are extrapolations, not measured current-batch prices or spending caps.
New tender document counts and lengths are unknown because mapping downloaded no PDFs.
The 302 known_baseline_missing IDs are not necessarily already read; verify readiness and receipts before reuse or any paid execution.
Mapping does not establish current eligibility, source validity, document completeness or semantic QA.
Known costs are calculated from recorded usage, not reconciled provider invoices.
validation: Principal decimal arithmetic independently checked offline; official public price documentation read; no inference, new source query, PG or Redis mutation, worker restart or deployment.
